description.value: Triple O's is the quick-service burger concept under the White Spot family, BC's longest-running restaurant chain operating since 1928. Located on Kingsway in Vancouver, this location features a drive-through and outdoor seating. Cyclists passing through the Burnaby-Vancouver corridor on Kingsway will find it a convenient stop for burgers and BC-sourced ingredients.
